name: 56085 · Sleepy Eye, MN
findings: ZIP 56085 (Sleepy Eye) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56085 (Sleepy Eye) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56085 (Sleepy Eye) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
